values.meaning: duration the fire field lasts on the ground
values.quote: impacts the ground to create a field of fire that lasts {{fd|4.5}} seconds

values.meaning: tick interval of the burning damage
duration of the Burning mark before it expires if not refreshed
maximum duration a target can be kept Burning by refreshing, capping total ticks at 20
values.quote: Enemies may be ''Burning'' for up to 5 seconds, for a total of 20 instances of its effect.

mechanics.claim: Enemies struck by impact or standing in the field are marked Burning, taking damage every 0.25s and being slowed, and this mark refreshes while the target remains in the area.
mechanics.quote: Enemies struck by the impact or within the field are marked ''Burning'' for 1 second, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds and being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%, refreshing while in the area.

mechanics.claim: A target can be kept Burning for at most 5 seconds total, capping the burn at 20 damage ticks even with continuous refreshing.
mechanics.quote: Enemies may be ''Burning'' for up to 5 seconds, for a total of 20 instances of its effect.

mechanics.claim: A given field only checks for targets to apply/refresh the debuff once every 0.25 seconds (tick timing detail, not per-target).
mechanics.quote: A given field checks for targets to apply or refresh the debuff on once every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Deployment along the target line takes 0.75 seconds during which rockets progressively land.
mechanics.quote: deploys a barrage of rockets from the sky along the target path in a line over {{fd|0.75}} seconds
